items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily, no WR elevation, pushing to play; optimism he goes barring setback. Schefter: flak jacket if plays.
items.why: Rib; better than anticipated progress, limited Friday
items.implication: Likely active but possible reduced role/efficiency; monitor inactives
items.opportunity: If out, large roles for Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris (22%+ shares post-exit W1)

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) listed Q but expected to play vs Ravens. Rapoport corroborates with Chase Young also expected.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no setback

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee); Schefter notes elevations including Myarick/Cody White.
items.why: Knee (meniscus trim); limited Friday practice, pregame test possible but unlikely
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; Mayer is primary TE
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role as TE1, routes/targets

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; targets redistribute in BAL offense
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL WRs and TEs like Mark Andrews

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots (foot); no practice midweek.
Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT Week 2 vs Bengals (hamstring Grade 1 from Wed practice; DNP Thu/Fri).
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz low-end TE1 upside; deep WR flexes

items.text: Rams listed Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness) for MNF vs Giants; Jordan Whittington doubtful (quad). No practice Saturday.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness different from camp psoas; GTD Monday
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; monitor warmups
items.opportunity: If out, heavier TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and WR bump to Konata Mumpfield or others

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans.
items.implication: Burrow likely starts; monitor for limitations

items.text: On Nacua Q: If misses, heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson); biggest WR bump Konata Mumpfield (if Whittington also out). Have pivot for MNF.
Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris project 5+ targets; large roles if McConkey out (22% shares after his W1 exit). Johnston >5 even if McConkey plays.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (team lead); IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite W1 usage + soft run matchup

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
items.implication: RB1 upside even in committee potential

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% targets from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ Wentz; CHI soft vs WR.
items.why: Massive target share + QB chemistry + matchup

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, air yards heavy; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return + poor W1 rushing share

items.text: The Rundown Week 2 live: game-by-game review of ETR content/projections/assumptions including injury contingencies.
items.why: Concise actionable takes from team incl Levitan/Silva

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util W1, 26% targets, all RB RZ touches; CLE soft vs run.
HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WR.
LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home smash, WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; high implied total.
